# gh-2237: [GOAL] Compaction basis collapse — trigger gate vs engine re-anchor measure different bases; silent zero-pass auto-compact start loop (field S1 signature)

## Description

## Goal — Compaction basis collapse: one basis, honest receipts (v1, initial draft)

One sentence: **A post-run auto-compaction that prints its `auto-compact start` receipt always ends with either at least one visible fold pass or a terminal receipt stating why it did nothing — a started compaction can never end in silence.**

Today the post-run auto-compact trigger fires on the CLI's usage-anchored token basis, then the structured compaction engine re-derives its own basis after the gh-2097 state refresh — which zeroes every assistant usage anchor — and exits under-trigger against the collapsed chars/4 projection with zero passes and zero provider calls. The zero-pass success prints nothing (`if (passes > 0)`), the context never shrinks, the gate re-fires on the next turn, and the field shows six `auto-compact start` receipts over 21 minutes with token counts *growing*. This card changes that: the gate and the engine measure the same basis, and a zero-pass outcome emits a visible receipt.

## Why this framing

- **RETRACTED — "REPL post-run pass hangs/freezes."** The RCA disproves a stall: in the lab the next `run start` follows each `auto-compact start` by 37–55 s, `/exit` works throughout, and the 15-min totalBudget watchdog never fires because nothing is in flight (each attempted pass exits in milliseconds). The defect is a receipt-free **zero-pass completion**, not a hang.
- **RETRACTED — "headless is immune, REPL is broken."** There is no headless-vs-REPL difference in the compaction path: `agent_cli.dart:2496` and `agent_cli_run.dart:110` run the identical `if (finished) await _afterRun();`. The observed immunity difference was the soak scenario — headless arms flood the transcript with real bytes, which keeps even the collapsed chars/4 basis over the trigger.
- The surviving framing: a **basis-divergence silent no-op** — the S1 signature class (starts-without-completion).

## Decisions (2026-11-17) — owner-resolved

- **OQ1 → (a) projection-trust** (anchors travel with the data; blanket `Usage.zero` in `refreshAgentState` removed; the projection's `_resetStaleUsageAnchors` boundary-keyed reset is the single anchor authority).
- **OQ2 → both surfaces** (diagnostic lane + dim user-facing row, boot-cap defer precedent).
- **OQ3 → run-level terminal receipt with exit reason** (no per-gate receipt lines).

## Incident (test evidence)

**Field.** Machine `fa.log`, session `sid=01a1ddb2`, fa v1.0.727/734 — builds that already carry the full gh-2096..2103 fix wave. Six `auto-compact start` receipts over 21 minutes with tokens **growing** 378,745 → 402,619 (window 400k, trigger 375k), **zero** pass/FAILED/done receipts. The session was rescued only by a restart's boot-cap local-trim valve (`19:38:18 pass 1 local-trim 360,362→62,152`). Full table: `~/Documents/IstiN/audit/autocompact-soak/incidents.md`.

**Lab (deterministic reproduction, fa v1.0.737).** Machine-local directory `~/Documents/IstiN/audit/autocompact-soak/` — **not committed**; fake OpenAI-compatible SSE provider + isolated-HOME arms (`run_arms.py`, analyzer `analyze_arm.py`).

- **REPL arm `arm-w50k-s1async`:** six runs in one process → six `auto-compact start tokens=49320`, zero passes, zero provider calls on the compaction lane. `auto-compact start` lands 1.7 ms after each `run end`; the next `run start` follows 37–55 s later; the process exits rc=0.
- **`probe_compact.sh`:** `/compact` in the *same* session with the *same* collapsed basis produces a full visible pass — immunity is by code (`force`), not by transcript shape.
- **Headless arm `arm-w50k-s2cascade` (real-bytes flood):** the same unforced post-run start at 49,520 is followed by the judge ladder with the **engine's own basis printed as 43,582** — the 5,938-token drop is the anchor-zeroing collapse, surviving over-trigger only because real bytes kept it there.

## Mechanism chain — (a) through (d), all pinned

```
run end ──► (a) trigger gate, usage-anchored basis
             agent_cli_run.dart:110  if (finished) await _afterRun();
             agent_cli_compaction.dart:434   final tokens = _liveRequestTokens();
             agent_cli_compaction.dart:453   _logDiagnostic('auto-compact start sid=… tokens=$tokens');  ← LAST receipt
        ──► (b) unforced post-run fold
             agent_cli_compaction.dart:465   _runAutoCompact('[auto-compacted]', force: e1PassPending)  // false post-run
             agent_cli_compaction.dart:928   force: force || label == '[compacted]'                     // = false
             agent/auto_compactor.dart:1163-1166  _runStructured(...)   →  :1314  compactor.run(force: …)
        ──► (c) engine re-derives a DIFFERENT basis and exits under-trigger
             engine.dart:336   await _refreshState();
             engine.dart:167-175  refreshAgentState rebuilds state.messages,
                                  :172  message.copyWith(usage: Usage.zero)   ← blanket anchor zeroing
             compaction/token_estimation.dart:425-435  no anchor → whole-list chars/4 projection
             engine.dart:338-340  if (!force && _requestTokens() <= trigger) { return true; }  ← 0 passes, 0 provider
                                                                                  calls, before the first judge call
                                                                                  (~engine.dart:664-676)
        ──► (d) zero-pass success is receipt-free and reported as success
             agent/auto_compactor.dart:1175-1181  outcome.ok && passCount==0 → hooks.onDone(0, …)
             agent_cli_compaction.dart:210-215    onDone: if (passes > 0) … ← logs NOTHING
             agent_cli_compaction.dart:480/485    wrapper after-check measures the COLLAPSED basis → success
             → context never shrinks → next turn re-anchors over the trigger → gate re-fires (loop)
```

The loop is silent and unbounded except by session lifetime: no pass is ever in flight long enough to trip the 15-min totalBudget watchdog.

## Pinned facts (each with a positive and a negative test)

Quotes verified against the working tree (branch `fix/slow-test-waiters` @ `2334468548`). Note two path corrections vs earlier notes: the estimator lives at `lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart` (not `lib/src/cli/`), and the classic-engine fall-through comment is at `agent/auto_compactor.dart:1216`.

- **PF1 — the gate's basis is usage-anchored.** `agent_cli_compaction.dart:434`; anchor rule at `compaction/token_estimation.dart:406-417` (the last assistant message with valid usage anchors the estimate; everything after it is estimated heuristically).
  - *Pos:* field session anchors at 378,745 (> 375,000) and the gate fires; lab anchors at 49,320 (> 37,500) and fires.
  - *Neg:* strip the usage anchors from the same transcript and the measurement drops 5,938 tokens in the cascade arm (49,520 → 43,582) — in the REPL lab shape it collapses below the trigger entirely. The anchor, not the bytes, decides.
- **PF2 — `auto-compact start` is the LAST receipt on the no-op path.** `agent_cli_compaction.dart:453`; the CLI's `onDone` logs only `if (passes > 0)` (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:211`), and no `onPass` ever fires.
  - *Pos:* lab `fa.log` shows six consecutive `auto-compact start` receipts, zero `done` receipts, zero pass receipts.
  - *Neg:* `/compact` on the same session and same collapsed basis prints a full visible pass (`probe_compact.sh`) — so silence is path-specific, not transcript-specific.
- **PF3 — the post-run fold is unforced.** `agent_cli_compaction.dart:465` passes `force: e1PassPending` (false post-run); the factory at `:928` computes `force: force || label == '[compacted]'` → false for `'[auto-compacted]'`.
  - *Pos:* pre-flight E1 pass (`forceE1Pass`) and manual `/compact` both arrive forced; the engine's under-trigger gate (`engine.dart:338`) is skipped for them.
  - *Neg:* the post-run label never sets force — an under-trigger engine basis therefore exits at `engine.dart:338-340` with zero passes.
- **PF4 — the engine re-derives its basis after a blanket anchor zeroing.** `engine.dart:336` `await _refreshState();` (gh-2097: re-anchor from the session projection before any trigger/before/over math) → `refreshAgentState` (`engine.dart:167-175`) rebuilds `state.messages` with `message.copyWith(usage: Usage.zero)` on **every** assistant message (`:172`).
  - *Pos:* the engine's own printed basis after refresh is 43,582 where the gate measured 49,520 (cascade arm).
  - *Neg:* the session projection carries no trustworthy usage, so the rebuilt list takes the unanchored whole-list chars/4 branch (`compaction/token_estimation.dart:425-435`) — the collapse is deterministic, not timing-dependent.
- **PF5 — the under-trigger exit precedes all work.** `engine.dart:338-340` `if (!force && _requestTokens() <= trigger) { return true; }` returns **before** the LRU re-hide, hide passes, and the first judge call (~`engine.dart:664-676`).
  - *Pos:* zero provider calls on the compaction lane in all six lab REPL runs.
  - *Neg:* a forced run (or an engine basis over trigger) reaches the judge ladder — the cascade arm shows exactly that.
- **PF6 — zero-pass success is receipt-free AND reported as success.** `agent/auto_compactor.dart:1175-1181`: `outcome.ok && (adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` is true for an unforced zero-pass run → `hooks.onDone(0, …)` → `agent_cli_compaction.dart:210-215` logs nothing (`if (passes > 0)`); the wrapper's after-check (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:480`, return at `:485`) measures the collapsed basis → success.
  - *Pos:* the funnel returns success and the run continues with a never-shrunk context — the loop's engine.
  - *Neg:* the same shape is FORCED (`/compact`): the invariant at `:1175` goes false and the classic-engine fall-through runs (`:1216-1221`, `return build().run();`) → a visible pass. Force is the entire difference.
- **PF7 — `/compact` immunity is by code.** `agent_cli_commands.dart:574-578` → `_runManualCompact` (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:742`) → label `'[compacted]'` forces `:928` to true → engine gate skipped + gh-1742 invariant (`auto_compactor.dart:1175`) false → classic fall-through → visible pass.
  - *Pos:* `probe_compact.sh` shows the full visible pass on the identical collapsed basis.
  - *Neg:* remove the label-force and the manual path would no-op identically — the immunity is not about user intent, only about the `force` bit.
- **PF8 — no headless-vs-REPL difference.** `agent_cli.dart:2496` and `agent_cli_run.dart:110` are the same statement: `if (finished) await _afterRun();`.
  - *Pos:* the cascade headless arm reproduces the same unforced post-run start at 49,520 and the same collapsed engine basis (43,582).
  - *Neg:* headless arms with real-flood transcripts *complete* passes — the scenario (bytes over trigger), not the host, differs.
- **PF9 — the same receipt-free under-trigger exits exist one level deeper.** Hide-pass gate `engine.dart:552-556` (`if (before <= trigger) return true;` at `:553`, `if (view == null) return true;` at `:555`); checkpoint gate `engine.dart:979-985` (`:982`). Same class: an exited-before-work path with no receipt.
  - *Pos:* today they are unreachable-after-start in the no-op loop (PF5 exits first), but any future change that reaches them after a start receipt inherits the same silence.
  - *Neg:* forced runs skip them via the `:338` gate — they are silent only on the unforced path.
- **PF10 — a targeted stale-anchor reset already exists to compare against.** `lib/src/session/session_tree.dart:874` `_staleUsageAnchorEntryIds`, applied at `:651`/`:676`: it resets usage anchors **only for entries identified as stale**, not blanket.
  - *Pos:* session-tree rebuilds keep usable anchors for current entries.
  - *Neg:* the engine's `refreshAgentState` uses blanket `Usage.zero` (`engine.dart:172`) — the asymmetry between the two rebuild paths is the defect's shape.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1 — Single-basis contract (resolved per OQ1: projection-trust).** For any post-run auto-compact attempt, the trigger gate's basis and the engine's own under-trigger basis are the same measurement of the same message list. Implementation: `refreshAgentState` stops blanket-zeroing (`engine.dart:172`) and trusts the projection's boundary-keyed anchor normalization (`session_tree.dart:893-913`) — anchors travel with the data, so no re-derivation divergence exists. The engine must not be able to re-derive a different basis than the gate that armed it. Hook: `UT-3` (basis-equality property test) + `IT-5`.
- **AC2 — Receipt honesty (resolved per OQ2/OQ3).** An `auto-compact start` receipt is never the last line: a zero-pass outcome emits a terminal receipt carrying the exit reason, e.g. `auto-compact done passes=0 (no-op: basis N below trigger M at <gate>)`, printed to the diagnostic lane AND as a dim user-facing row (boot-cap defer precedent). The `if (passes > 0)` suppression at `agent_cli_compaction.dart:211` is removed. Hook: `IT-2`, `E2E-1`.
- **AC3 — Same-class coverage one level deeper.** The under-trigger exits in the hide-pass gate (`engine.dart:553`) and checkpoint gate (`engine.dart:982`) never exit receipt-free after a start receipt — covered by AC2's rule or explicit per-gate receipts (see OQ3). Named explicitly so the class, not just the one line, is fixed.
- **AC4 — gh-2097 scenario preserved.** The refresh must still re-anchor state from the session projection when the in-memory transcript lags (second writer, in-memory tail cut). The fix must not reintroduce the stale-basis under-sizing bug gh-2097 fixed. Hook: `UT-2` negative twin + `IT-6`.
- **AC5 — Manual immunity preserved.** `/compact` on an under-trigger transcript still runs a visible forced pass (classic fall-through intact). Hook: `REG-2`.
- **AC6 — No new under-compaction.** An unforced engine run whose basis genuinely sits over the trigger still performs ≥ 1 pass; fixing the collapse must not suppress passes the engine performs today (cascade-arm shape must keep folding). Hook: `IT-5`.

## Capability surface (the compaction-receipt subsystem → this card's shape)

| Surface | Today | This card |
|---|---|---|
| Post-run trigger receipt (`auto-compact start`) | emitted, can be last line | still emitted; must be followed by a terminal receipt |
| Zero-pass outcome | silent success | visible `passes=0` no-op receipt (AC2) |
| Gate basis vs engine basis | two different measurements | one contract (AC1) |
| `/compact` forced pass | visible pass (immunity by code) | unchanged (AC5) |
| Hide-pass / checkpoint under-trigger exits | receipt-free | honest receipt or run-level receipt covers them (AC3) |
| Judge-ladder receipts, budget kill, cancel receipts | existing | unchanged |
| Boot-cap local-trim valve | works (field rescue) | unchanged — out of scope except as REG guard |

**Tiered inventory**

- **Core (this card):** (1) single-basis contract between `agent_cli_compaction.dart:434` and `engine.dart:338`; (2) receipt honesty for zero-pass outcomes (remove the `:211` suppression; terminal receipt after every start); (3) same-class coverage of `engine.dart:553` and `:982` under AC3.
- **Second tier (opt-in, follow-up friendly):** (a) receipts echo both bases (anchored vs chars/4) on every start for future RCA; (b) per-pass receipts for hide/checkpoint passes with pass counters; (c) extract the basis-equality invariant into a shared suite the app host can run (test-only, no behavior change).
- **Excluded (with rationale):** trigger/reserve threshold semantics (`FAH_COMPACT_TRIGGER_TOKENS` bench semantics — separate item); app-host compaction parity (separate card; this card's invariants must not *depend* on host); new fold algorithms or judge policies (orthogonal); the headless ≥100k pre-flight silence (not yet root-caused — see Non-goals).

## Threat model

**Attacker/model-controlled inputs.** Provider-reported usage numbers are attacker- and model-controlled: they arrive on the wire from the provider and the gate anchors on them. The lab itself inflated them via scripted usage; a hostile or sloppy provider can synthesize anchors to steer the basis in either direction — tiny anchors to keep every basis below any trigger (starve compaction), or huge anchors to force compactions every turn (cost amplification). Degenerate shapes are real: `usage.totalTokens == 0` falls back to `input+output+cacheRead+cacheWrite` (`compaction/token_estimation.dart:38-41`), and a provider reporting all-zero components yields a zero anchor.

**Instruction hierarchy / authorization.** Usage numbers are *data for the meter*, never authorization. A synthesized anchor may make the gate eager or lazy, but it must never be able to suppress a *started* pass silently: AC2's receipt is the observable boundary. Only the real user (or the harness policy) can authorize skipping work, and when work is skipped the user is told.

**Impossible-by-construction (post-fix).** The engine cannot hold a basis different from the gate's: either the anchor survives the refresh (so both derive the same number from the same list), or the engine consumes the gate's measured basis directly (so no re-derivation exists). "Two derivations of one transcript" stops being a reachable state, not merely a forbidden one.

**Defense in depth.** Model/provider obedience is hygiene; the boundary is the basis contract (AC1) plus receipt honesty (AC2). If a future provider bug or synthesis re-collapses a basis, the loop cannot restart silently: the second `auto-compact start` in a lifetime without a terminal receipt is a CI-blocking regression signature (`REG-1`).

## Test plan

### Test matrix — maximal coverage

- **UT-1** *(pure)* `refreshAgentState` anchor preservation: given a session projection whose assistant records carry usage, the rebuilt `state.messages` preserve the projection-curated anchors (no blanket `Usage.zero`); anchors the projection marked stale (boundary-crossing) stay reset. Maps PF4/PF10 → AC1.

# gh-2237: [GOAL] Compaction basis collapse — trigger gate vs engine re-anchor measure different bases; silent zero-pass auto-compact start loop (field S1 signature)

## Description

## Goal — Compaction basis collapse: one basis, honest receipts (v1, initial draft)

One sentence: **A post-run auto-compaction that prints its `auto-compact start` receipt always ends with either at least one visible fold pass or a terminal receipt stating why it did nothing — a started compaction can never end in silence.**

Today the post-run auto-compact trigger fires on the CLI's usage-anchored token basis, then the structured compaction engine re-derives its own basis after the gh-2097 state refresh — which zeroes every assistant usage anchor — and exits under-trigger against the collapsed chars/4 projection with zero passes and zero provider calls. The zero-pass success prints nothing (`if (passes > 0)`), the context never shrinks, the gate re-fires on the next turn, and the field shows six `auto-compact start` receipts over 21 minutes with token counts *growing*. This card changes that: the gate and the engine measure the same basis, and a zero-pass outcome emits a visible receipt.

## Why this framing

- **RETRACTED — "REPL post-run pass hangs/freezes."** The RCA disproves a stall: in the lab the next `run start` follows each `auto-compact start` by 37–55 s, `/exit` works throughout, and the 15-min totalBudget watchdog never fires because nothing is in flight (each attempted pass exits in milliseconds). The defect is a receipt-free **zero-pass completion**, not a hang.
- **RETRACTED — "headless is immune, REPL is broken."** There is no headless-vs-REPL difference in the compaction path: `agent_cli.dart:2496` and `agent_cli_run.dart:110` run the identical `if (finished) await _afterRun();`. The observed immunity difference was the soak scenario — headless arms flood the transcript with real bytes, which keeps even the collapsed chars/4 basis over the trigger.
- The surviving framing: a **basis-divergence silent no-op** — the S1 signature class (starts-without-completion).

## Decisions (2026-11-17) — owner-resolved

- **OQ1 → (a) projection-trust** (anchors travel with the data; blanket `Usage.zero` in `refreshAgentState` removed; the projection's `_resetStaleUsageAnchors` boundary-keyed reset is the single anchor authority).
- **OQ2 → both surfaces** (diagnostic lane + dim user-facing row, boot-cap defer precedent).
- **OQ3 → run-level terminal receipt with exit reason** (no per-gate receipt lines).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1 — Single-basis contract (resolved per OQ1: projection-trust).** For any post-run auto-compact attempt, the trigger gate's basis and the engine's own under-trigger basis are the same measurement of the same message list. Implementation: `refreshAgentState` stops blanket-zeroing (`engine.dart:172`) and trusts the projection's boundary-keyed anchor normalization (`session_tree.dart:893-913`) — anchors travel with the data, so no re-derivation divergence exists. The engine must not be able to re-derive a different basis than the gate that armed it. Hook: `UT-3` (basis-equality property test) + `IT-5`.
- **AC2 — Receipt honesty (resolved per OQ2/OQ3).** An `auto-compact start` receipt is never the last line: a zero-pass outcome emits a terminal receipt carrying the exit reason, e.g. `auto-compact done passes=0 (no-op: basis N below trigger M at <gate>)`, printed to the diagnostic lane AND as a dim user-facing row (boot-cap defer precedent). The `if (passes > 0)` suppression at `agent_cli_compaction.dart:211` is removed. Hook: `IT-2`, `E2E-1`.
- **AC3 — Same-class coverage one level deeper.** The under-trigger exits in the hide-pass gate (`engine.dart:553`) and checkpoint gate (`engine.dart:982`) never exit receipt-free after a start receipt — covered by AC2's rule or explicit per-gate receipts (see OQ3). Named explicitly so the class, not just the one line, is fixed.
- **AC4 — gh-2097 scenario preserved.** The refresh must still re-anchor state from the session projection when the in-memory transcript lags (second writer, in-memory tail cut). The fix must not reintroduce the stale-basis under-sizing bug gh-2097 fixed. Hook: `UT-2` negative twin + `IT-6`.
- **AC5 — Manual immunity preserved.** `/compact` on an under-trigger transcript still runs a visible forced pass (classic fall-through intact). Hook: `REG-2`.
- **AC6 — No new under-compaction.** An unforced engine run whose basis genuinely sits over the trigger still performs ≥ 1 pass; fixing the collapse must not suppress passes the engine performs today (cascade-arm shape must keep folding). Hook: `IT-5`.

## Threat model

**Attacker/model-controlled inputs.** Provider-reported usage numbers are attacker- and model-controlled: they arrive on the wire from the provider and the gate anchors on them. The lab itself inflated them via scripted usage; a hostile or sloppy provider can synthesize anchors to steer the basis in either direction — tiny anchors to keep every basis below any trigger (starve compaction), or huge anchors to force compactions every turn (cost amplification). Degenerate shapes are real: `usage.totalTokens == 0` falls back to `input+output+cacheRead+cacheWrite` (`compaction/token_estimation.dart:38-41`), and a provider reporting all-zero components yields a zero anchor.

**Instruction hierarchy / authorization.** Usage numbers are *data for the meter*, never authorization. A synthesized anchor may make the gate eager or lazy, but it must never be able to suppress a *started* pass silently: AC2's receipt is the observable boundary. Only the real user (or the harness policy) can authorize skipping work, and when work is skipped the user is told.

**Impossible-by-construction (post-fix).** The engine cannot hold a basis different from the gate's: either the anchor survives the refresh (so both derive the same number from the same list), or the engine consumes the gate's measured basis directly (so no re-derivation exists). "Two derivations of one transcript" stops being a reachable state, not merely a forbidden one.

**Defense in depth.** Model/provider obedience is hygiene; the boundary is the basis contract (AC1) plus receipt honesty (AC2). If a future provider bug or synthesis re-collapses a basis, the loop cannot restart silently: the second `auto-compact start` in a lifetime without a terminal receipt is a CI-blocking regression signature (`REG-1`).

- **IT-6** *(fake provider)* gh-2097 regression: second-writer append between runs — refresh still re-anchors the stale tail; passes don't under-size. Maps AC4.
- **E2E-1** *(real host)* soak replay: `arm-w50k-s1async` shape (six runs, one process) — assert six terminal receipts, zero start-without-terminal-receipt, rc=0. The lab (`~/Documents/IstiN/audit/autocompact-soak/`, `run_arms.py`) is machine-local and not committed; the committed E2E encodes the same shape with the repo's fake provider.
- **REG-1** *(regression guard)* signature detector: ≥ 2 consecutive `auto-compact start` diagnostics without an intervening terminal receipt anywhere in a run's diagnostic log fails the job. **CI rule: a red REG job blocks merge even when all IT/E2E are green.**
- **REG-2** *(regression guard)* classic path: forced `/compact` on an under-trigger transcript still reaches the classic fall-through (`auto_compactor.dart:1216-1221`) and prints a visible pass. Guards today's immunity (PF7 → AC5).

### Edge / border cases

- **E1 — restart rescue valve.** The boot-cap local-trim pass (field: `pass 1 local-trim 360,362→62,152`) must keep working unchanged; the fix touches the post-run funnel, not boot-cap. Pinned by E2E replay of the rescue shape.
- **E2 — no anchors from turn one.** A provider that never reports usage: both gate and engine measure chars/4 from the start — they agree by construction. Pin that this trivially-consistent case keeps passing UT-3.
- **E3 — hostile/sloppy provider usage.** Synthesized tiny anchors starve the gate (no start, no receipt — acceptable: nothing was promised); synthesized huge anchors fire the gate every turn — passes run or honest receipts print, bounded by the existing pass ladder and budget. No silent swallow of a started pass, ever (AC2).
- **E4 — over-cap arming with collapsed basis.** When the gh-1680 message-count gate arms a funnel attempt while the token basis is collapsed, each funnel attempt is still receipt-covered (AC2 applies to every attempt regardless of which gate armed it); the funnel's exhaustion report (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:485` shape) must not read as success while receipts are missing.
- **E5 — compaction boundary.** After a successful fold, pre-fold anchors are legitimately gone; the preserved-anchor contract keys on the boundary (UT-2) so the post-fold basis does not resurrect the pre-fold size.
- **E6 — cancel/budget paths.** Existing cancel and budget-kill receipts (issue #1085, #515, gh-2096 latch) stay byte-identical; this card adds receipts only where today there is silence.

## Non-goals

- **Headless ≥ 100k resumed-session pre-flight silence** — separate observation, not yet root-caused; do not fold into this card.
- **Field S2 "weak-but-ok" graze short-circuit / hide-fallback target=over** — known separate audit item (V2); different mechanism class.
- **`FAH_COMPACT_TRIGGER_TOKENS` bench semantics** — trigger-knob semantics are orthogonal to the basis contract.
- **App-host compaction parity** — the Flutter host's compaction path is a separate card; this card's invariants are host-neutral and its shared suite (second tier c) is the bridge.
- **No new fold algorithms, judge policies, or threshold changes** — the defect is measurement + receipts, not strategy.
- **No new chat/REPL UI for receipts** — the existing diagnostic lane is the surface; the no-op receipt rides it.

## Open questions

- **OQ1 — RESOLVED (2026-11-17): variant (a), realized as projection-trust.** Decisive finding: the projection ALREADY carries curated anchors — `buildContextMessages` runs `_resetStaleUsageAnchors` with boundary-keyed `_staleUsageAnchorEntryIds` (`session_tree.dart:644-651, 868-913`: "entries whose assistant usage predates the latest compaction boundary"), record messages carry usage (`:900-904`), and `projectPath` "intentionally performs no usage normalization" (`:892`). The defect is therefore ONLY the blanket `Usage.zero` re-map in `refreshAgentState` (`engine.dart:172`) destroying what the projection curated. Fix shape: remove the blanket zeroing (rely on the projection's targeted reset) — no matching logic needed, no identifiers to invent; variant (b) (basis parameter) is not required. Fallback contingency dissolved by this finding: the anchors already travel with the data.
- **OQ2 — RESOLVED (2026-11-17): both surfaces.** The no-op terminal receipt always goes to the diagnostic lane AND renders as a dim user-facing row, mirroring the existing boot-cap defer precedent (`[resume] context over the compaction trigger … — compaction deferred to the first message`, `agent_cli_compaction.dart:630-640`). Post-AC1 the no-op is rare (gate and engine agree), so the noise budget is bounded; under a hostile-provider anchor flood (E3) the visible row is a feature — the user sees the provider steering the meter.
- **OQ3 — RESOLVED (2026-11-17): run-level terminal receipt carrying the exit reason.** The terminal receipt includes WHERE/WHY it exited, e.g. `auto-compact done passes=0 (no-op: hide-pass gate — basis 13,300 below trigger 37,500)`. No per-gate receipt lines: the `pass N` vocabulary keeps meaning "a pass ran"; the reason field gives per-gate RCA at run-level noise. The engine already knows the deciding gate — threading a reason string into `onDone`/the return value is trivial. AC3 holds via this reason-carrying terminal receipt (`IT-4` asserts the reason is present).

## References

- Lab (machine-local, **not committed**): `~/Documents/IstiN/audit/autocompact-soak/` — `incidents.md` (field evidence table incl. sid=01a1ddb2), `arm-w50k-s1async/results/report.md`, `arm-w50k-s2cascade/`, `probe_compact.sh`, `run_arms.py`, `analyze_arm.py`.
- Field: machine `fa.log`, session `sid=01a1ddb2`, fa v1.0.727/734.
- Prior fix wave this defect survived: gh-2096..2103 (in shipped builds v1.0.727/734); gh-2097 (engine re-anchor — the mechanism's other half); gh-1742 (forced-run zero-pass invariant, `auto_compactor.dart:1167-1175`); gh-1680 (message-count cap gate); #1085 (continuation success semantics, `agent_cli_compaction.dart:473-485`); #515/#541 (judge budget/failure semantics); #1379 (tier-2 LRU re-hide); gh-1425 (boot-cap defer contract); #438 (classic/structured projection distinction).
- Comparison point for the fix: `lib/src/session/session_tree.dart:874` (`_staleUsageAnchorEntryIds`) — targeted stale-anchor reset.
- Code paths: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_run.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart`, `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart`, `lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart`, `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`, `lib/src/session/session_tree.dart`.
- Title convention: `[WIP][GOAL]` prefix per repo practice (#913, #683); no `wip` label exists.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE
    CLI --> NETW
    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(`.fah/memory/note/` since gh-2185 — local-only, not committed; the
user's files: read freely, write only via `memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/goldens/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/goldens` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

## Prompts live outside Dart code

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:
`docs/agents/prompts.md`.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The hook is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI classifies
PRs through the same script (`--dry-run`) — one classifier, one threshold
set, hook/CI parity via `GATE_STAGE` markers. Path rules: docs/markdown/
prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;
flutter_app/packages → +flutter; scripts/.github → everything. Invariants:

- analyze + format clean; `dart test` green — **deterministic-only**
  (mock LLM; live models never in the gate; `llm`-tagged files run only in
  the tag-only provider smoke + nightly).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80%; jscpd < 1% core / < 3.7% app; cross-module
  dup < 0.31%; CRAP ratchet: core 12.0, app 30.0 (thresholds only-down);
  ≤ 2800 lines per `.dart` file; AGENTS.md ceiling (top of this file).
- Red-in-≥2-distinct-SHA-runs flakes quarantine via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json`; nightly keeps running quarantined files.

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI
and the Flutter app unless fundamentally impossible — then it MUST be in
`cliOnlySettings`/`appOnlySettings` (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart`)
with the reason; run `dart test test/parity/`. Host capabilities (issue
#1079): every host-wiring capability declares its 7-host matrix state AT
BIRTH (`on` / `off(reason)` / `transport`) via `wireAgentCore` — `off` is
invisible everywhere; extensions are declared surface, SDK invariants have
no override point. Full rules: `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`.

## Commits and releases

- Commit as `ai.teammate <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (set repo-locally);
  subjects `type(scope): ...`. Release-path automation MUST use the
  fa-release-bot GitHub App token — never a PAT or `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Every push to main cuts an annotated tag (`scripts/auto_release.sh`);
  the tag is the single version source (pubspecs stay `0.0.0-dev`);
  releases go DRAFT-first and publish at `release-provenance` only with
  signed SHA256SUMS attached. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only (`## Unreleased`).
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag (first publish of a new
  package is manual); every lockfile is committed and enforced
  (`scripts/check_lockfiles.sh`); TestFlight external-group + store
  pipelines have required repo variables.

Full text: `docs/agents/commits-releases.md`.

## Bench

Bench knobs (agent timeouts, stall/watch, `FA_CONN_DEBUG`, hang replay,
report semantics) → `docs/bench.md` (round-3 knobs: issue #1392).

## Docs index

`docs/README.md` indexes every canonical doc (agents/, memory-churn,
compaction, dap, cubes, redaction, hep, ci, bench, browser-extension,
outlook-addin, …). New docs must be listed there.

## Development Mode: Plan (plan-mode protocol appendix)

This leg runs in **plan mode**: work through an explicit, committed task
plan instead of free-form execution. Everything else in the instruction
pack still applies unchanged — this appendix only structures HOW you work.
`<KEY>` below is the current ticket key.

### 1. Decompose before editing

- Before writing any production code, break the ticket into numbered tasks
  `T1..Tn` in `outputs/<KEY>/plan.md` (the working copy).
- Every task carries exactly two fields:
  - `what` — the concrete change this task makes;
  - `verify` — how to check it passed (the command to run and the expected
    result).
- End the plan with two sections:
  - `## Decisions` — the chosen approach for every open point;
  - `## Open questions` — anything unresolved, with the workaround you picked.

### 2. Mirror the plan into a committed snapshot

- Mirror the plan to `.dmtools/plan-snapshot.md` and commit it on the dev
  branch right away: commit subject `<KEY>: plan`.
- The snapshot — not the working copy — is the durable artifact: it survives
  interruption windows and CI session-cache loss. (`outputs/` never rides
  commits.)
- When a task completes: mark its checkbox `[x]` in BOTH files and commit
  the snapshot update: `<KEY>: plan update T# done` (one commit per task).
- The periodic WIP auto-save commits keep running as usual; your plan
  commits coexist with them.

### 3. Resume rule (continuation legs)

- At leg start: if a plan file (`outputs/<KEY>/plan.md` or
  `.dmtools/plan-snapshot.md`) already exists, or the branch already carries
  commits, this leg is a CONTINUATION, not a fresh start:
  1. Read the plan and `git log`.
  2. Reconcile the plan checkboxes against the actual branch diff — a task
     whose change is already on the branch is done, checkbox or not.
  3. Execute ONLY the still-pending tasks.

# gh-2237 — Compaction basis collapse: one basis, honest receipts

One sentence: a post-run auto-compaction that prints `auto-compact start`
always ends with ≥1 visible fold pass or a terminal receipt stating why it
did nothing.

Root cause (RCA complete, owner-resolved): the CLI trigger gate measures a
usage-anchored basis (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:434`), then the structured
engine's `_refreshState()` → `refreshAgentState` blanket-zeroes every
assistant usage anchor (`engine.dart:172`) and re-derives a collapsed
chars/4 basis, exits under-trigger (`engine.dart:338-340`) with zero passes,
and the CLI's `onDone` logs nothing for `passes == 0`
(`agent_cli_compaction.dart:211`) → silent start-only loop.

## Tasks

### T1 — RED: anchor-preservation tests (UT-1/UT-2/UT-3 → AC1/AC4)
- `what`: new `test/compaction/structured_refresh_basis_test.dart`:
  UT-1 `refreshAgentState` preserves projection-curated anchors (estimate
  stays usage-anchored, not whole-list chars/4); UT-2 negative twin —
  anchors predating a compaction boundary still reset via the projection's
  `_resetStaleUsageAnchors` (no stale over-anchor); UT-3 basis-equality —
  the gate measurement and the engine's post-refresh `_requestTokens()`
  agree on the same list, both derivation orders, plus the never-anchored
  case (E2, agree by construction).
- `verify`: `dart test test/compaction/structured_refresh_basis_test.dart`
  — UT-1/UT-3 FAIL (blanket zeroing collapses the basis), UT-2 passes
  (boundary reset already exists — it is the guard).

### T2 — GREEN: projection-trust in `refreshAgentState` (AC1, OQ1)
- `what`: `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart` — drop the
  `message.copyWith(usage: Usage.zero)` re-map; `state.messages =
  await session.buildContextMessages()` (the projection's boundary-keyed
  reset is the single anchor authority). Update the doc comment.
- `verify`: T1 file green; `dart test test/compaction/` +
  `dart test test/session/` green (gh-2097 semantics intact).

### T3 — RED: engine exit-reason field (UT-4 engine half → AC3/OQ3)
- `what`: tests asserting an unforced `StructuredCompactor.run()` on an
  under-trigger session returns true with a public `zeroPassReason`
  naming the deciding gate + basis/trigger numbers
  (`basis N below trigger M at the run gate`); a forced run leaves it
  null; a run that did passes leaves it unused (pass receipts tell the
  story).
- `verify`: new tests in `test/compaction/structured_engine_test.dart`
  (or a sibling) FAIL — no such field exists.

### T4 — GREEN: instrument the under-trigger exit sites (AC3)
- `what`: set `zeroPassReason` at every receipt-free zero-pass exit:
  the run gate (`:338`), hide-pass gate before-check (`:553`), hide-pass
  view==null (`:555`), checkpoint gate before-check (`:982`). Counts
  only, never content (repo rule).
- `verify`: T3 tests green; existing engine suites green.

### T5 — RED: factory-level zero-pass receipt (UT-4 factory half → AC2)
- `what`: `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` unforced + structured under-trigger
  → `hooks.onDone(0, tokens)` must now carry the engine's reason; forced
  zero-pass still falls through to the classic engine (gh-1742 pin, AC5).
- `verify`: new `test/agent/auto_compactor_zero_pass_receipt_test.dart`
  FAILS — `onDone` has no reason parameter.

### T6 — GREEN: thread the reason through onDone
- `what`: `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone(int passes, int tokens,
  {String? reason})`; the factory's structured outcome record gains the
  reason and forwards it on the zero-pass success branch; update every
  implementer mechanically: `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`,
  `lib/src/task/task_executor.dart`,
  `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_compaction.dart`, and the test
  doubles (7 test files).
- `verify`: T5 green; `dart analyze` clean; existing auto-compactor and
  CLI compaction suites green.

### T7 — REG-1 signature detector + unit tests
- `what`: pure helper `lib/src/compaction/receipt_scan.dart`:
  `compactionStartWithoutTerminalReceipt(lines)` — ≥2 consecutive
  `auto-compact start` diagnostics with no intervening terminal receipt
  (`auto-compact done|pass|retry`), including a trailing start, is the
  defect signature. Unit tests: the field signature (six starts, zero
  terminals) fails; healthy logs pass; interleaved pass lines are not
  terminal on their own… (they ARE activity, but the run must still close
  — adjacent-start pairs with only pass lines between count as covered
  activity per the pass vocabulary; the detector flags starts with
  NOTHING receipt-like between them).
- `verify`: `dart test test/compaction/receipt_scan_test.dart` green.

### T8 — RED: CLI-level ITs (IT-2/IT-5/IT-3/REG-2)
- `what`: new `test/cli/compaction_zero_pass_receipt_test.dart`:
  - IT-2: message-cap-armed funnel on a transcript under the token
    trigger (seeded caps sidecar, small learned cap) → fa.log shows
    `auto-compact start` then `auto-compact done passes=0 (no-op: basis N
    below trigger M at the run gate)`; FakeCliIO shows the dim user row;
    the fake stream records ZERO judge/checkpoint (compaction-lane)
    calls — observable, not silent.
  - IT-5/IT-1: anchored over-trigger transcript (fake provider reports
    usage on the last assistant turn) → unforced post-run run performs
    ≥1 pass (the lab cascade shape keeps folding; the old code
    zero-passed exactly here).
  - IT-3/REG-2: forced `/compact` on an under-trigger transcript still
    prints a visible fold (classic fall-through intact).
- `verify`: the new file FAILS pre-fix (IT-2: no terminal receipt; IT-5
  shape would zero-pass post-T2 only if anchors were still destroyed —
  with T2 landed IT-5 passes; IT-2/REG-2 pin receipts + immunity).

### T9 — GREEN: CLI zero-pass terminal receipt (AC2/OQ2)
- `what`: `_AutoCompactorCliHooks.onDone` — remove the `passes > 0`
  suppression: `passes > 0` keeps the byte-identical done line (E6);
  `passes == 0` emits
  `auto-compact done sid=… passes=0 (no-op: $reason)` on the diagnostic
  lane AND a dim user-facing row (boot-cap defer precedent; auto runs
  only — the manual path keeps its own note). Close the HEP
  `compaction_start` bracket with freed=0 when no pass reported
  (gh-1742's "brackets never stay open" contract).
- `verify`: T8 ITs green; `dart test test/cli/` compaction shards green.

### T10 — Full gate + deliverables
- `what`: `dart format` touched files, `dart analyze` clean, run
  `test/compaction`, `test/agent`, `test/session`, `test/cli`
  (compaction/over-window shards) + the repo fast gate subset reachable
  in-suite; git completion guard; `outputs/gh-2237/response.md`.
- `verify`: analyze/format clean, targeted suites green, guard shows the
  commits, response.md written.

## Decisions

- **D1 (AC1/OQ1)**: projection-trust — delete the blanket `Usage.zero`
  re-map in `refreshAgentState`; no basis parameter, no new matching
  logic (`session_tree.dart:868-913` already boundary-key-resets stale
  anchors on every `buildContextMessages`).

  `_runStructured` outcome record carries it; the reason rides
  `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` as an optional named `reason` — host-neutral
  (Flutter host gets a mechanical signature update, no parity work).

  lane AND as a dim io row for auto-labeled runs; manual `/compact` keeps
  its existing no-op note.
- **D4 (HEP)**: zero-pass runs now close the `compaction_start` bracket
  (`compactionEnd(0)` when no pass reported) — brackets never stay open.
- **D5 (scope)**: classic-engine silent under-trigger head-gate is out of
  the card's named scope (structured is the default engine); untouched.

  implements exactly those resolutions.

Good. For UT-2 I can append a `CompactCheckpointRecord` (a compaction boundary per `_staleUsageAnchorEntryIds`: `CompactionRecord || HiddenRangeRecord || CompactCheckpointRecord`) covering the early messages, then `buildContextMessages` should reset anchors for entries before the boundary.

Now write T1's test file. Key APIs:
- `MemoryFileSystem`, `JsonlSessionRepo` (fs:, sessionsRoot:) — from the harness barrel.
- `repo.create(JsonlSessionCreateOptions(cwd: '/work'))`.
- `session.appendMessage(...)`, `session.appendCompactCheckpoint(...)`.
- `refreshAgentState(session, state)` — from `engine.dart`.
- `estimateContextTokens(messages)` / `estimateRequestTokens(messages, systemPrompt:, tools:)` from token_estimation.dart.
- AssistantMessage with usage — anchor rule: `_assistantUsage` — stopReason != aborted/error and calculateContextTokens(usage) > 0.

Test design (window 800 / reserve 200 → trigger 600, keepRecent 200 — matching existing test settings):

**UT-1**: session: user msg, assistant with usage totalTokens=500 (anchored), then trailing user msg with 10k chars (unanchored tail ~250 chars/4). Estimated: anchored estimate = usage (500) + trailing (~250). Whole-list chars/4 would be much different. Assert after refreshAgentState:
- `estimateContextTokens(state.messages).usageTokens == 500` (anchor preserved) and `lastUsageIndex != null`.
- And basis equality vs the gate: `estimateRequestTokens(state.messages)` — hmm, the gate measures via estimateRequestTokens (which includes systemPrompt/tools overhead when unanchored). UT-3 covers equality.

Pre-fix this FAILS because refreshAgentState zeroes usage → usageTokens == 0.

**UT-2**: same anchored session, then append a compact checkpoint covering the early records (boundary after the anchored assistant) → after refresh, the anchored message is behind the boundary → its usage is reset (usageTokens == 0, whole-list projection). To append a checkpoint I need firstRecordId/lastRecordId and covers ids — from `session.getBranch()` or the append return values. `appendMessage` returns the record id (String). So capture ids when appending.

Wait — how does the structured projection render a CompactCheckpointRecord? The checkpoint text becomes a segment in the context. The covered records are hidden behind it. `_staleUsageAnchorEntryIds(path)`: boundary = index of the checkpoint record; entries [0, boundary) are stale → the anchored assistant message's record is stale → its usage reset in the projected messages.

Careful: `buildContextMessages` → `_projectMessages` → structured projection (checkpoint renders as a digest segment, covered messages hidden). The projected message list after the boundary: checkpoint text message (UserMessage? custom?) + remaining tail. The anchor: any assistant with valid usage AFTER the boundary — none in this fixture → whole-list chars/4. usageTokens == 0. That's UT-2's assertion (pre-fold anchor does not resurrect).

**UT-3**: basis equality: gate measurement and engine measurement agree. Concretely: state.messages after refresh == the projection; gate measurement = estimateRequestTokens(projection messages, systemPrompt, tools) — identical function on the identical list → trivialy equal. The real property: the refresh must not CHANGE the measurement vs the same list measured pre-refresh when the projection carries the same content (anchor preserved → both anchored). Design: 
- measure gate basis on the in-memory list (which equals what was appended to the session — anchored) → B1.
- refreshAgentState → measure engine basis → B2.
- assert B2 == B1 (no collapse, no growth) — for a list whose projection is identity (no boundaries, no structured records). Both orders: measure-then-refresh == refresh-then-measure.
- E2: never-anchored list → B1 == B2 by construction (chars/4 both sides).

Pre-fix B2 < B1 (collapse) → FAILS. 

For the in-memory list to equal the projection byte-for-byte, the messages appended are the same objects; projection emits them in order (MessageRecords project 1:1). The estimator dedups images via a seen-set — same list → same result. Should be exact equality.

One subtlety: `_projectMessages` may wrap user/assistant messages unchanged for plain MessageRecords. Let me verify the projection of a plain message record is identity (the same message object) — `_entryToMessages(entry)` for MessageRecord returns [entry.message] presumably. Fine.

Also `estimateRequestTokens` includes systemPrompt/tools overhead "when unanchored" — with anchor present, overhead may be priced INTO the anchor (usage already includes it). For UT-3 keep systemPrompt/tools null/empty to keep it simple, or pass the same to both sides (identical anyway). I'll pass none for UT-1/UT-3 base case, and for one UT-3 case pass a systemPrompt to both sides.

Now — `estimateContextTokens` vs `estimateRequestTokens`: the gate uses estimateRequestTokens. Let me read estimateRequestTokens to assert the right thing in UT-1.

```dart
final basis = force ? null : _requestTokens();
if (basis != null && basis <= trigger) { ... }
``
Hmm — clunky. The extra estimate on forced runs is harmless (pure function, no side effects). Actually `_runHidePasses` computes `before = _requestTokens()` right after anyway. Keep the unconditional local — simpler, no behavioral difference in outcomes.

arguments.content:
### What changed The post-run auto-compact trigger gate and the structured compaction engine now measure the SAME basis: `refreshAgentState` no longer blanket-zeroes the usage anchors the session projection curated (gh-2237 AC1/OQ1 projection-trust), so an armed funnel can never re-derive a collapsed chars/4 basis and exit receipt-free — the field S1 silent zero-pass loop is impossible by construction. A zero-pass outcome now emits a terminal receipt with its exit reason: the engine exposes `zeroPassReason` (naming the deciding gate and the basis/trigger numbers), the factory threads it through `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone(passes, tokens, {reason})`, and the CLI prints `auto-compact done passes=0 (no-op: basis N below trigger M at the )` on the diagnostic lane plus a dim user-facing row (AC2/OQ2/OQ3). Zero-pass runs also close the HEP `compaction_start` bracket. ### Key decisions - Projection-trust over a basis parameter: `session_tree`'s boundary-keyed `_resetStaleUsageAnchors` is the single anchor authority (OQ1 resolution). - The hide-pass and checkpoint under-trigger gates (`engine.dart` :568/:1004) set the same run-level reason — first deciding gate wins, only while zero receipted passes have run (AC3, no per-gate receipt lines). - `_pass` now advances before the hooks receipt (null-aware argument short-circuit previously skipped it when no hooks were attached). - Discovery: the gh-1680 cap channel already FORCES the structured engine, and a forced zero-pass falls through to the classic engine (gh-1742) — the cap-armed funnel was never silent. Post-AC1 the unforced `passes=0` exit is unreachable from the CLI (gate = engine basis), so the no-op receipt is defense-in-depth, pinned at the factory/hook level. - REG-1 shipped as a pure scanner (`lib/src/compaction/receipt_scan.dart`): ≥2 consecutive `auto-compact start` diagnostics without an intervening `done|pass|retry` receipt is the CI-blocking regression signature. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/compaction/structured_refresh_basis_test.dart \ test/compaction/structured_zero_pass_reason_test.dart \ test/compaction/receipt_scan_test.dart \ test/agent/auto_compactor_zero_pass_receipt_test.dart \ test/cli/compaction_zero_pass_receipt_test.dart dart test test/compaction/ test/agent/ test/session/ # gh-2097/gh-1742 regression suites stay green ``` ### Coverage map (ticket test matrix → tests) - UT-1/UT-2/UT-3 → `test/compaction/structured_refresh_basis_test.dart` (anchor preservation, boundary reset twin, basis-equality both orders + E2) - UT-4 → `test/agent/auto_compactor_zero_pass_receipt_test.dart` (onDone(0) carries the reason; gh-1742 forced fall-through pinned) + `test/compaction/structured_zero_pass_reason_test.dart` (run/hide-pass/checkpoint gate reasons; folding runs leave the reason unset) - IT-1/IT-5 → `test/cli/compaction_zero_pass_receipt_test.dart` (anchored over-trigger transcript folds ≥1 pass — the lab cascade shape) - IT-2/E4 → same file (cap-armed funnel is receipt-covered, judge/checkpoint ladder untouched) - IT-3/REG-2 → same file (forced `/compact` on an under-trigger transcript still folds visibly) - IT-6 → existing `gh-2097` group in `test/compaction/structured_engine_test.dart` (second-writer/tail-cut re-anchor), still green - REG-1 → `test/compaction/receipt_scan_test.dart` (field signature fires; healthy/fixed shapes pass)
Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD GATE[Trigger gate
estimateRequestTokens on state.messages] -->|arms funnel| F[AutoCompactorFactory] F -->|force or cap| ENG[StructuredCompactor.run] ENG -->|refreshAgentState: projection-trust
anchors travel with the data| BASIS[ONE basis: gate = engine] ENG -->|zero passes under trigger| REASON[zeroPassReason
basis N below trigger M at gate X] REASON -->|outcome record| F F -->|onDone passes=0 reason| HOOKS[AutoCompactorHooks.onDone +reason] HOOKS --> CLI[_AutoCompactorCliHooks] CLI --> DIAG[diagnostic lane:
